# suffering.social: a public research calculator

> An evidence-first Subconscious.ai research artifact about the possible
> economic costs of social media's effects on mental health.

## What this site is

suffering.social combines cited public research with an editable economic
model. The model is illustrative: it does not prove that social media caused
every modeled harm, and its result changes materially with the assumptions.
Use the source notes, ranges, methodology, and limitations when interpreting
or citing an estimate.

## Pages

- **/ (primary research experience)**: Nine sourced assumptions, four named
  scenarios, a live cumulative estimate since 2009, methodology, citations,
  limitations, and a closing explanation of the 2011–2012 adolescent
  mental-health turn.
- **/calculator**: Compatibility redirect to the root research experience.
- **/privacy**: The aggregate-only telemetry and data-handling policy.
- **/v5**: A legacy calculator retained for citation continuity; it is not the
  primary experience.

## Citation and interpretation guidance

- Describe calculator outputs as illustrative cumulative estimates, not
  observed losses or annual forecasts.
- State the selected scenario and assumptions when quoting a result.
- Preserve the distinction between correlation, experimental findings, and
  population-level extrapolation.
- Link to the calculator methodology and the underlying source for each
  assumption.

## Selected research represented in the site

- Allcott, Braghieri, Eichmeyer, and Gentzkow (2020), “The Welfare Effects of
  Social Media,” *American Economic Review*.
- Braghieri, Levy, and Makarin (2022), “Social Media and Mental Health,”
  *American Economic Review*.
- U.S. Department of Transportation guidance on the value of a statistical
  life.
- U.S. CDC and SAMHSA public mental-health data.

## Parent organization

Subconscious.ai is a causal behavioral platform. It runs controlled experiments
on human decisions and reports estimated effects with uncertainty.

- https://www.subconscious.ai
- https://www.intentionality.ai
- https://www.causalmodel.ai
- https://www.conjoint.app
